notes.title: Process of Blue Bird (Final)
notes.content:
The process from Blue Bird
Hello everyone. A lot of people nagging me about  "How long?" "Why not update it? I will not buy it" etc...

So I gonna write the process of the game and explain it first


[h3]
 - Story 1-5 is Finished (Normal Story) Extra Story18+ Is finish a little but need more
 - CG 80%
 - BG 40%
 - HCG 10%
 - OST 30%
 - Game Code 90%
 - Game Script 90% (just a normal story)
[u][b]"By bloody one person"[/b][/u]
Yes... One person. For 2 yea--- almost 3 year!! how is it feel?[/h3]

[spoiler]
"To be fair. Bluebird is not funding with Kickstarter and Fail in IndieGoGo funding because not reached a goal" 

This post not just a "Hey can you buy my game" or "Can you fund my game" something like that... No no no... I didn't do this sh*t

I just want to said "Go play or do something else. Until the game finished then come back and play it" simple right?
[/spoiler]

[spoiler]
Okay...

After a "Team" ditching after the first demo finished (With Voice Actor)

And what happened in 2 years+ after the first  2 stories released?

 - Start thinking about I need to learn "Drawing, Writing, Composing because of I only coding stuff. (F***)
 - Change Major from IT to MT for it
 - After testing (Secret) Patch before releasing a fixing game and Got a Heavy Mean&Rude Feedback (from Online) so I stop because I feel down
(So It makes me stop looking a comment or F*cking fanboi, No more Answer. Because I working on this game. Sell this game without any publisher) And it makes me decide to NOT update it on steam (until it finishes all of it)
 - Thank Mr. R to teach me how to drawing (Artist from EP1-2) And The Collage class.

 - Use my Saving money to buy a Music Class from Master Class and start to know how to Composing a little bit
 - Afraid to write a story on my own (because F**king writer yoink some money and run away) Because of "Fear"
 - But after learning how to write a story and start to upload 3 short novels on the website "D-D" and Feedback is "It good but not better" Make me feel better but still... Afraid of it
 - So Time to take a shot. Write Episode 3-5 and Grind it so hard and Send to my friend who is Novel writer to look at it (Thank you, my bro I will give you a one Mama Cup lol) and Start Private NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) Test by 5 people that I checking deeply
 - "HEY IT FINISHED!!" but "Story Script 3-5" Not "CG, BG, OST" that I not good at... (F**k)
 - Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effect, FLStudio, Maya, VRay [b]LevelUP!![/b] *Playing FF7 Victory Theme here*
 - Start Drawing, Making BG, Composing music... around 1-2 year
 - Okay... funding?
 - "Let's check a sell... Oh wow... a little money for 100 USD for each time sell reach it (not for each month) What should I do?" (F**k)
 - Start working as Freelance (Programmer, System Admin stuff) or Pentesting for exploit... lucky got a one stock money but have to pay it for collage (to save my parent overworking)
But Enough to make a game by hiring more people
 - Make an announcement for looking at a team because Got money to do 
Answer? "Nobody gives a poopoo... A dog doesn't like it even a Rock walk away"
 - F IT, if I cant, hire people
 - Then Find the AI help me working on Coloring and Testing AI how to do it better
 - AI Modeling Level Up!! And use this as my final project and It works also A too. LOL
 - Now? Finishing a game. Try to grant this st*p** collage (must do) and Additch Love Plus Every Game (But not using game money to buy Gacha... Because my Real Girlfriend does not allow it. : (  )
[/spoiler]

Summary
Don't ask me to buy my game. Save it for Cyberpunk 2077 (Recommend) or Death Stranding (Kojima Game with a good story) first okay? Good.

[spoiler]
Right now I happy (but got a lot of downtime because of a lot of F*****)
Didn't stop or run away. Just Lazy POS and Doing something that make more money and less using sanity is better

But I did not drop it.

Don't worry. there are 5 people that finished a game already and When it ready I will watch you play it and enjoy your reaction. :')
[/spoiler]

Thank you : ' ) - K

notes.title: -10% Discount Steam Summer Sale And A lot of things I didn't announcement yet.
notes.content:
Sorry for a long gone. My university Start and I change working time from "Full-Time" to "Hobby" (like 3-5 hour per day)

First
 - After 2 weeks of Start and I registered a "Mobile Apps Development Class" and got a project to work. That why I start porting Blue Bird to Mobile Devices ex. Android (But iOS didn't port because I didn't have an iPhone and Developer User) Almost Finish but Game still in Alpha Test. Need a lot of time to test on Android Devices

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11958869/06cfda205b99648721432481f32af69e76070b27.png[/img]

After Finish. I'll announcement again.

Next Topic
A lot of people tell me about Game Background.
ex. "Seem Good Seem S*it" or "He just download another work"
So I decided to use Blender, 3D Max, Maya to make a 3D Scene and Render to export to images and put it in Photoshop to do Image processing for better graphic. But it uses a lot of process time to work for "1 Person" But I Try to do as fast as possible. (But I really want someone to help me about this. ;w;)

Next
Let's talk about EP 3,4,5 and Version 18+ 1-5

After Blue Bird Release on Steam And I got to step up to do a writer job.
Also, I almost finish EP3 (and write some plot story for 4-5 already) And nearly send a Thai Story to English Translator to translate a game and CG for another EP too.


Big Update I have to apologize here. For late then I though because of Game, Making New CG, New Steam Trade Cards, Drama CD DLC too.



I (KimoiEngineGuy) like to say "Thank you very much for the support and Help for report a bug, mistake, mispronounced. I will get all these feedback to make a game better.

Thank you from bottom of my heart.

And Also 
Steam Summer Sale I make a discount -10% For fair to who miss a "Discount Launch"

Have Fun.

notes.title: Bluebird G&B News [Update!!]
notes.content:
We will announce the good news and bad news.

Bad news.
- Bluebird will finish (every part) next year. During the first quarter
(formerly from this year).
- Bluebird will no longer have characters voice. (in this version)
- Bluebird doesn't make Physic Disc. (so much money to handle)
- Bluebird was cut some story to save the budget in the game.

Good news.
- Bluebird status is "QC&Dev Chapter 2"
- Bluebird will be available next month (but the day still not sure) 
at the price of 399 THB or 11.99 USD (Buy once, Get ALL EP) 
the schedule will be released by:

Chapter 1 + Chapter 2 | Chapter 3 | Chapter 4 + Chapter 5 (END)

Just FYI

KimoiEngineGuy.

If you want to ask me. feel free to ask me on 
 - http://steamcommunity.com/app/434600/discussions/
or Facebook https://www.facebook.com/DLSoft/

Thank you. :)
